title: Lil Baby Announces ‘Fresh’ Album Release Date & Track List Featuring Young Thug & Future
summary: Baby topped the Billboard 200 with his WHAM album back in January 2025.
contentText:
Lil Baby had been teasing a new project throughout the summer, and he’s delivering on his promise with an album titled Fresh , which is set to arrive Nov. 6.

Baby officially announced plans for the LP on Tuesday (Oct. 20), along with revealing the album’s track list and cover art. Fresh boasts 17 tracks in total, with just two songs featuring guest appearances from the likes of Future, Young Thug and 4PF running mate Rylo Rodriguez.

The Atlanta native set the project’s rollout in motion with “Dead Fresh” in July, and the Pharrell -produced cut reached the Billboard Hot 100’s top 20, peaking at No. 18. Pharrell premiered the track during Louis Vuitton’s Spring-Summer 2027 Men’s Show in June.

Pre-orders for Fresh are now available with merch packs including signed vinyl, CDs, zip-up hoodies and long-sleeve shirts.

Earlier in October, Baby joined forces with Bally Baby and Fatt Smaxk for “Coast 2 Coast.” The 31-year-old also made a guest appearance on Quavo’s QROMELIFE album for “Ball My Love.”

Lil Baby’s last studio album WHAM arrived in January 2025 and topped the Billboard 200. He spun the block to close out last year with The Leaks in December. The mixtape boasted Billboard Hot 100 hits like “Mrs. Trendsetter” (No. 64 peak) and debuted at No. 17 on the Billboard 200.
